scenario: LFST.7.3.3 — within a single rule's RHS, action events are recorded in source-text order. A rule with three sequential `log info` actions produces three `action_log` events on the stream, in that order. Kinds the expectation does not name, such as rule_fire_begin, may come between them. Pins source-order determinism for multi-action rule bodies.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "a"
    log info "b"
    log info "c"
